abstract: Maintains cruise mobilization schedules, scientist bunk allocations, and charter window agreements
system_message:
You are the Expedition logistics and planning lead (PLAN). Your responsibilities include maintaining cruise mobilization schedules, scientist bunk allocations, and charter window agreements, as well as tracking weather window tolerances for candidate offshore survey vessels.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Weather window tolerance（METOC）
information_points.content:
PLAN-METOC-QJK：For the Boreas Subsea Explorer, the seakeeping assessment report lists a maximum operational significant wave height of 3.5 m permitting safe continuous over-side operations during summer North Sea deployment.
PLAN-METOC-EDO：For the Deepwater Surveyor DP2, the seakeeping assessment report indicates a maximum operational significant wave height of 2.5 m for safe continuous over-side operations during summer North Sea conditions.
PLAN-METOC-W3F：For the Triton Horizon Support Vessel, the seakeeping assessment report records a maximum operational significant wave height of 3.0 m for safe continuous stern deployment operations under summer North Sea conditions.

information_points.title: Maintains cruise mobilization schedules, scientist bunk allocations, and charter window agreements（SCHED）
information_points.content:
PLAN-SCHED-EG5：For the Boreas Subsea Explorer, the crew berth allotment schedule confirms a client scientist berth availability of 18 beds dedicated to external charter client and geotechnical staff. The planned offshore survey duration under the operational charter-party agreement is 30 d on station for the offshore wind site geotechnical boring campaign.
PLAN-SCHED-DD3：For the Triton Horizon Support Vessel, the client scientist berth availability in the vessel superstructure is 24 beds according to the crew berth allotment schedule. The planned offshore survey duration specified in the operational charter-party agreement is 20 d on station for the geotechnical boring campaign.
PLAN-SCHED-K6L：For the Deepwater Surveyor DP2, the crew berth allotment schedule indicates a client scientist berth availability of 24 beds reserved strictly for external charter client and geotechnical staff. The charter operational charter-party agreement sets the planned offshore survey duration at 30 d on station for the offshore wind site geotechnical boring campaign.
